references.title: The nucleotide sequence of the lac operator.
references.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A. 1973;70(12):3581-3584

label: lacO
note: lacO: the 17 bp core of the lac operator O1, the LacI binding site of the E. coli lac promoter. Gilbert & Maxam 1973 sequenced the repressor-protected fragment, about 27 bp long, and published 24 bp of it: TGGAATTGTGAGCGGATAACAATT. This part is an interior window of that sequence; its own ends are not the ones the paper reports and are unverified. The 24 bp form is annotated on the catalog's Plac as 'lac operator O1', the 21 bp form on Ptac and T7lac.

provenance.sequence_source: Gilbert & Maxam 1973 (PMID 4587255): an interior 17 bp window of the 24 bp lac operator sequence they report (TGGAATTGTGAGCGGATAACAATT); the window's own ends are unverified
